items.raw_excerpt: You’ve lived in your rented apartment in Austria for years—but suddenly your landlord says they need it back for personal use. Is this allowed? Here’s what the law says.
items.summary_en: A reader asked about Austrian tenant rights when a landlord wants to reclaim a rental property for personal use. The article explains what the law says about this situation.

items.raw_excerpt: High summer temperatures are set to return later this week after a cloudy start with showers in many places around the Netherlands. By Monday afternoon, the sun will increasingly break through the clouds and temperatures will eventually reach between 19 to 23 degrees, according to Weeronline. Tuesday afternoon will see the temperature rise, and by the afternoon it will already be a summery 25 degrees or more. Wednesday and Thursday will be hot, with temperatures topping 35 degrees in some...
items.summary_en: Summer heat is coming back to the Netherlands. Temperatures will reach 25 degrees by Tuesday afternoon. Wednesday and Thursday could be very hot, with temperatures topping 35 degrees.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드에 다시 더운 여름 날씨가 찾아온다. 화요일 오후면 기온이 25도 이상으로 오른다. 수요일과 목요일에는 35도를 넘는 폭염이 예상된다.

items.raw_excerpt: Nguyen Tuong Anh built her university application essay out of classical Chinese poems, and the 18-year-old from Hanoi won a place at Tsinghua University along with a full Chinese government scholarship to Beijing Normal University.
items.summary_en: Nguyen Tuong Anh, an 18-year-old from Hanoi, wrote her university application essay using classical Chinese poems. She was accepted to Tsinghua University and received a full scholarship to Beijing Normal University.

items.summary_en: Firefighters responded to a blaze on the railway line in Carlton, a small village near Selby in North Yorkshire. A train driver reported the three-metre fire early on Monday morning. Crews put out the fire and handed the scene to a Network Rail officer.
items.summary_ko: 영국 노스요크셔 칼튼 마을의 철도변에서 화재가 발생했다. 한 열차 기관사가 새벽 1시 45분경에 화재를 발견해 신고했으며, 소방대가 출동해 3미터 크기의 불을 진화했다. 인명 피해는 없었다.
items.title_en: Fire breaks out next to railway line in North Yorkshire village

items.raw_excerpt: Veteran Taiwanese baseball player Yang Dai-Kang (陽岱鋼), who built a successful career in Japan's Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) as an All-Star outfielder, announced Monday that he will retire at the end of the 2026 season, bringing his 21-year professional career to an end.
items.summary_en: Veteran Taiwanese baseball player Yang Dai-Kang announced his retirement from Japan's Nippon Professional Baseball at the end of the 2026 season. He spent 21 years as a professional player and was an All-Star outfielder in Japan's top league.
items.summary_ko: 대만 출신 베테랑 야구 선수 양대강이 일본 프로야구에서 21년간의 선수 생활을 마무리하며 2026 시즌 뒤 은퇴를 발표했다. 그는 일본 최고 리그에서 아웃필더로 활약하며 올스타에 뽑혔던 선수다.
items.title_en: Former NPB all-star Yang Dai-Kang to retire after 21-year career
